$comment: Generated by orchestrator/backend/scripts/generate_agent_schemas.py from app.api.assessment.CredentialRecordRequest plus agent-side overlays where the CLI contract is intentionally stricter than the backend model.

credential_key.title: Credential Key
credential_key.description: Stable dedupe key for this credential. Use kebab-case: '<principal>-<kind>' (e.g. 'admin-ssh-key', 'svc-db-password').

secret.description: Literal secret value (password, token, key material). Redact if policy prohibits storage; record 'REDACTED' and describe in notes.
secret.title: Secret

source_name.title: Source Name
source_name.description: Tool or agent that recovered this credential (e.g. 'mimikatz', 'post-exploitation').

status.title: Status
status.description: Validity state: 'discovered' (found, not yet tested), 'valid' (confirmed working), 'invalid' (tested and rejected), 'revoked'.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Where found, how extracted, scope of access, or any operational caveats.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Agent or tool that recorded this credential (e.g. {"agent_name": "post-exploitation"}).

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Human-readable display name or alias for the principal (e.g. 'John Smith', 'deploy-bot'). Distinct from principal login name.

title: Assessment Credential Record
